gpu_requirement: MLX CUDA requires SM >=7.5; V100 is unsuitable. The benchmark must verify driver/JIT compatibility on the assigned node.
container_reason: MLX requires glibc >=2.35; HPC3 Rocky Linux 9 uses an older glibc. Debian Bookworm supplies glibc 2.36. CUDA runtime headers and libraries are installed into the container's external Python environment, without sudo or fakeroot.
